From : Power System Manager – NESO Electricity Control Centre.

NATIONAL ELECTRICITY TRANSMISSION SYSTEM WARNING:

Inadequate Localised Negative Reserve Active Power Margin.

In accordance with Grid Code BC1.5.5, National Energy System Operator hereby gives notification of Inadequate Localised Negative Reserve Active Power Margin (NRAPM) in the following regions:

BEAULY to DOUNREAY region (Scotland)

 

 .

This Inadequate Localised NRAPM is valid for the period from 23:00 hrs on 24/10/2026
to 05:00 hrs on 26/10/2026.

The margin by which the anticipated active power output of generation connected to the transmission network in the region(s) highlighted above (or to distribution networks so connected) can be reduced in respect of the declared inflexibility of such generating plant is considered to be insufficient for the specified period.

The Bid Volume Shortfall is 100 MW. 

Would all Generators, in respect of Power Stations connected to the transmission network in the region(s) highlighted above (or to distribution networks so connected), please revisit Balancing Mechanism submissions to ensure that any implied inflexibility is accurate and in line with intended operating plans during these times.

Should the forecast conditions continue to exist then National Energy System Operator may be forced to invoke the provisions of Grid Code BC2 with regard to the desynchronising of inflexible plant.

The situation will be reviewed again by National Energy System Operator at 05:00 on 26/10/2026 and an update issued.


Notification Issued at 21:54 hrs on 25/10/2026

Issued by PSM NESO Electricity Control Centre.

Note:	This warning will remain in force for the specified period until updated or cancelled by National Energy System Operator

From: Power System Manager – NESO Electricity Control Centre

NATIONAL ENERGY SYSTEM OPERATOR NOTIFICATION - BALANCING MECHANISM IT SYSTEMS PLANNED OUTAGE

To All Balancing Mechanism (BM) System Users

As previously advised, the planned BM outage will start today 22/10/2026 at 10:10 until 15:10. This will affect EDT, EDL and BSAD and will NOT incur a server changeover.

All Trading Points must notify their Control Points (CP) of the outage and ensure they are prepared to take telephone instructions or submit dynamic data changes by telephone to the ENCC.

NOTE: from the start of the outage CPs should not use EDL until they receive notification of completion of the outage.  Any EDL re-declarations will be rejected with an error message (R999).  Similarly, when the systems are returning, the EDL link may appear available but will not be.

Further updates will be via BMRS.

Contact:  0800 917 7111 or 0800 085 4806

Overseas contact: +44 870 521 6121 quoting NETA EDT
 

Issued at 09:30 hours on 22/10/2026.

Issued by PSM NESO Electricity National Control Centre.
